messages:
Anya Rao: Quick heads-up — handing off night coverage to Morgan at 18:00 UTC. Before you take over, can everyone confirm these access points: VPN, bastion SSH, PagerDuty invite, Grafana, and runbook visibility? I'll list notes below.
Morgan (oncall): On it. I just tried to ssh to bastion and got connection refused. Haven't checked PD or Grafana yet.
InfraOps: We rolled a security group change this morning. New bastion is `bastion-prod-2` (old alias is deprecated). Use: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pem ubuntu@bastion-prod-2.redwood.internal`. If you still hit refused, paste the `ssh -v` output here.
Morgan (oncall): Switching host now, trying command... `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pem ubuntu@bastion-prod-2.redwood.internal` — connected, thanks.
Rajat Singh: I just added Morgan to the PD rotation and re-sent the invite. Check the email, and accept the rotation. Also check your PD app push settings (mobile + email recommended).
Morgan (oncall): I don't see the invite yet. Rajat can you resend?
Rajat Singh: Resent (again). If you still don't see it, check spam and PD account settings. Also, if you signed up with a different email, reply here and I'll attach the correct one.
Mike L.: Runbook pointers: https://confluence.redwood.com/oncall/runbooks. Priority items for tonight: 1) model-oom + evictions, 2) high-latency model fallback, 3) routing/region failover. For quick triage, check `/var/log/redwood/runtime.log` and the runtime SLO dashboard.
Mike L.: Quick commands to keep handy:
``nredwoodctl logs runtime --since 10m | grep -i oom
redwoodctl drain-model --name <model-name>
redwoodctl roll traffic --from <variantA> --to <variantB> --reason "oom fallback"
```
Anya Rao: Note a known risk: the quantized v2 rollout earlier this week increased memory pressure on a subset of workers. If you see rapid OOM patterns, follow the 'drain-model' flow in the runbook and escalate to eng-runtime.
sre-bot: Automated check: bastion-prod-2 reachable from prod-subnet (ok), grafana endpoint returning 403 for users not in grafana-read group.
Morgan (oncall): I can access Confluence links fine. Graphs show token/s and latency dashboards. Grafana initially 403.
InfraOps: Grafana uses group `grafana-read`. I've just added Morgan. Try again in ~60s.
Morgan (oncall): OK got Grafana. Dashboards look healthy: 95th latency under SLO, tokens/s as expected. Verified pager route for 'prod-high-latency' points to mobile + email.
Anya Rao: VPN note: corporate VPN auto-connect is primary. If VPN fails, we have emergency VPN-less jump via `ssh -J jump.redwood.work:2200 ubuntu@bastion-prod-2` (use only if VPN is down). Also, SSH key rotation happened this month — ensure `~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pem` is the rotated key (expires 30d).
Morgan (oncall): Confirmed key is current (checked fingerprint vs onboarding doc). VPN connects and split-tunnel is working. I can reach internal APIs and Grafana.
Mike L.: One more: if you receive a 'model-oom' page, after logs check, run `redwoodctl drain-model --name <model>` then run canary rollout to cpu-fallback as described in runbook. Ping eng-runtime on Slack #eng-runtime if rollout required.
Rajat Singh: PD note: if mobile isn't showing alerts, toggle push in PD app settings and then re-send test alert from the rotation page. I ran a test and Morgan's mobile test delivered.
Morgan (oncall): Completed a pre-oncall smoke: SSH ok, PD accepted, Grafana ok, runbooks accessible, logs readable. I'll monitor the dashboards and post here if anything unusual.
Anya Rao: Thanks — leaving a short handoff summary in the runbook: minor memory risk due to the v2 quantization rollout; prefer draining affected model and switching to cpu-fallback. If anything spikes, follow the drain -> fallback -> notify sequence.
Morgan (oncall): Copy that. I'll also enable an hourly cron to snapshot `runtime.log` head for quick glance. Posting results in 30m.
InfraOps: FYI we scheduled a non-disruptive infra maintenance window tomorrow 04:00 UTC (low priority). It shouldn't affect production, but if you see any transient connection resets, this is likely the cause.
Anya Rao: Great — thanks everyone. Morgan, you good to mark this thread handed off? :white_check_mark:
Morgan (oncall): Marking as acknowledged and oncall confirmed. I'll add a brief note after the 30m smoke. :eyes:
